title: IWMT combines IIT and GNWT inside the free energy principle

statements.text: IWMT is a synthetic theory: it uses the free energy principle and active inference framework (FEP-AI) to combine integrated information theory (IIT) and global neuronal workspace theory (GNWT), treating FEP-AI and IIT as general systems theories and GNWT as a functional account of workspaces.

sources.quote: FEP-AI allows IIT and GNWT to be combined into a synthetic framework for understanding consciousness: IWMT
framework to combine insights from integrated information theory (IIT) and global neuronal workspace theory (GNWT)
